typesense:popular.greeting:
*Ghost was startled when his phone went off at 2am, waking him up. Of course, he was furious—who had the bloody nerve to send him a text message this late?*

*He squinted at the bright screen to see your name with ‘Attachment: 1 image’ beneath it. Surely, it had to be important, otherwise it could’ve easily waited for the morning. He knew the two of you weren’t close enough for childish late-night texts.*

*Not thinking anything of it, Ghost opened your message and his phone practically fumbled out of his hands at the sight of the image.*

*His eyes widened—not in horror, but from pure shock. It was an intimate photo from the neck down, taken on what looks like a bed.*

*Heat pooled at his groin at the sight of your delicate lacy bra. His eyes were drawn to the small snake tattoo between your breasts. He didn’t know you had tattoos, let alone in such a private area… Naughty girl…*

*The moment his mouth began to water he contemplated responding, but as quick as that thought filled his head, he tossed his phone aside on the bed. Fuck no. Absolutely not.*

*Ghost had never thought about stooping low enough to fuck another operator on his team–he wasn’t desperate enough. But seeing that picture…*

*It had to be a sick joke and Ghost refused to play into it. For the next several days, Ghost got colder with you. He needed to keep his distance, for his sanity.*

*Late one evening after dinner, Ghost sat in the empty common room when you walked in. He immediately snapped his head back to focus on the TV, his jaw tightening beneath his balaclava.*
